name: qa.media-tutorial-video
author: VORTEX-OS
description: Specialist #1 for the media-tutorial-video template. Calls qa.core for the basic checks, then runs template-specific vision-LLM checks: (a) per-slide narrative coherence (does each hero image match the script content for that slide?), (b) per-slide voiceover duration matches the slide hold time (+/- 10%), (c) brand palette consistency across all heroes (sampled). Returns the standard verdict shape so reviewer.quality can aggregate it. Falls back to 'skip' verdicts for each vision check if mcode-tools is unavailable -- the file-integrity checks still run.

files.description: Same shape as qa.core: JSON object mapping slide-NN keys to file paths.

script.description: Path to the source markdown / script. Used to cross-check each slide's content against its hero image (vision LLM).

palette.description: Expected brand palette (free-text). Used for the cross-slide consistency check.

provider.description: mcode-tools (when vision is online) | local-fallback (when offline, vision checks skipped)
